title: Riot Squad Exotic Fruit Frenzy 10ml Nic Salt 20mg
description: Riot Squad Salt’s Exotic Fruit Frenzy is a tantalising tropical rush of juicy, mouth-watering, sun-soaked flavour. The bold, fresh tang of Pineapple pairs perfectly with juicy, luscious Mango to create a flavour that is sweet and satisfying and endlessly uplifting. Riot Squad’s Riot Salt e-liquids are formulated with hybrid nicotine, a unique and innovative blend of nicotine freebase and nicotine salts. The combination of the freebase and salt nicotine provides fast relief from nicotine cravings with a smooth throat hit that’s slightly more tactile than regular nic salt. Riot Squad’s Hybrid Salt formulation offers vapers the most realistic alternative to a cigarettes to help people stop smoking successfully. The e-liquid’s 50/50 PG and VG ratio also provides the perfect balance of flavour and throat hit.
